description: Section 12.4 S7: inventory of the legacy Central Admin karrygo/dispatch router (direct Karryam operational database access through dispatchPrisma) mapped to the approved path HQ -> PIC -> Karryam Admin -> Bridge. Verified by infrastructure/scripts/tests/product-admin-s7-legacy.test.mjs against the router source and the pinned 435-capability registry.
legacy_mount_note: src/app.js does not mount this router (verified by tests/product-gateway.test.js), so it serves no traffic. Cutover therefore means: never re-mount it, prove parity of the replacement reads/commands in staging, then remove the module, the dispatch Prisma client and DISPATCH_DATABASE_URL after owner approval.
replacement_permissions: HQ product grant for product_id=karryam (resource.read / command.submit), dataset/scope containment, recent MFA; writes are R3 two-person (Section 11) - stricter than legacy by design

parity.notes: rider list is scope-filtered (market/organization/zone/tenant) in the replacement
verification steps/audit come from verification.command.history in the replacement
owner-executed, independent approval, readback via verification.command.readback; never auto-approved

routes.owner_confirmation_required: the exact dispatch command type for rider suspension must be confirmed by the Karryam Dispatch owner

parity.notes: missions are the source term for dispatch trips
exact location trails are not exposed by the replacement (privacy class)

routes.owner_confirmation_required: asset approval command type (verification vs fleet) must be confirmed by the owner

rollback: Nothing to switch back: the legacy router stays unmounted. If a replacement route regresses, disable its HQ grant or its command family (S6 rollback); legacy data access is never re-enabled without a new owner decision.
